meta.title: How we work
meta.description: From idea to support in six stages with defined deliverables: discovery, design, development, testing and security, delivery and support.

hero.title: A clear process, from idea to support
hero.lead: Six stages with defined deliverables, frequent communication and security present from the start. Timelines are indicative: they depend on the scope of each project.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.summary: We understand the problem before proposing a solution.
discovery.description: We talk with the people involved to understand goals, users, constraints and risks. We review what already exists and agree on scope, priorities and how success will be measured.

design.title: Design
design.summary: We design the experience and the architecture with security on the table.
design.description: We define flows, interface and architecture, and run a threat model to decide which controls the system needs before a single line of code is written.

development.title: Development
development.summary: We build in short cycles, with continuous review and testing.
development.description: We work in two-week iterations with a demo at the end of each one. All code goes through review and automated testing, and dependencies are monitored continuously.

security.title: Testing and security
security.summary: We verify that it works, that it is fast and that it holds up.
security.description: Before every release we validate functionality, performance, accessibility and security. When the project calls for it, we run penetration tests within the scope and authorization we have agreed.
security.duration: 1–2 weeks, on top of continuous testing
outputs: List of accepted risks, if any

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.summary: We deploy and hand the knowledge over.
delivery.description: We put the system into production through a reproducible process and deliver it with its documentation. We train your team so that it can operate and evolve the solution.

support.title: Support
support.summary: We stay by your side after launch.
support.description: After delivery we agree on a stabilization period to fix issues. Afterwards you can opt for a plan of maintenance, monitoring and continuous improvement.

collaboration.title: Transparency at every stage

cadence.title: Steady rhythm
cadence.text: Two-week iterations with a demo at the end of each one.

channel.title: Direct channel
channel.text: You talk to the people building your project, with no middlemen.

visibility.title: Everything in view
visibility.text: Task board, documented decisions and risks visible to you.

collaboration.note: The timelines shown are indicative and are confirmed in the proposal.

cta.title: Shall we start with discovery?
cta.lead: Tell us about your project and within a few days you will have a proposal with scope, timelines and investment.
